content: Ishaan Bose followed up regarding the renewal of his DCoders health policy, requesting confirmation of any changes to premium or coverage before signing the new form. Karan Joshi confirmed there are no changes to the policy details, apologized for the previous auto-renewal issue, and instructed Ishaan to proceed with signing. Karan also attached the policy document for reference.
